result.notes: Gumroad's official vendor docs page (gumroad.com/api) is a JS-rendered SPA that couldn't be fetched as static text, so primary evidence comes from Gumroad's own API endpoint (Doorkeeper OAuth realm) plus a detailed third-party integration guide (Rollout) and a token-creation walkthrough (gumkit.app) that both describe the same self-serve flow: log into any free Gumroad account, go to Settings > Advanced, create an application (get client_id/secret for OAuth2) or click "Generate access token" for a personal bearer token — no approval queue. No official Gumroad-published MCP server found; multiple community/open-source MCP wrappers exist (rmarescu/gumroad-mcp, keithah/gumroad-mcp). API is small (~6 resource groups: products, offer codes, sales, subscribers, variants/custom fields, license verification).
result.one_liner: Gumroad is an ecommerce platform for creators to sell digital products, courses, and memberships directly to customers.
